_comment: Film 55 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5 via fal, 6 tracks, 2026-11-17). One track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H | 1 | 2,3 | M,4,5 | 6,7 | 8,A2 + end screen). Files in <scratch>/f55/audio/music, not in the repo. M0 starts with a loud swell at 0.7-2 s: cues.json skips it (off 6). M5 is placed so its natural decaying end is the film's end (off 32).
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, thoughtful documentary about the most powerful artificial intelligence being kept behind closed doors. No drums, no percussion, no vocals, no melody hook, not epic. Very quiet, even dynamics, slow tempo 60-66 BPM.

M0.mood: night, an enormous closed door, gold light in the gap, a quiet line; one felt-piano note over a low warm drone, curiosity and a hint of unease, bowed glass, airy pads

M1.chapter: 1 (the lab: Fermat, 11 days -> 30 hours, A1, the inspector)
M1.mood: machines writing out a proof line by line; slowly pulsing warm pads, sparse felt piano, glass tones like a ticking ledger, low strings; second half a patient questioning tension

M2.chapter: 2, 3 (safety, Mythos, the giants, C1, the defenders)
M2.mood: a hidden flaw in old code, a guarded door; cool, restrained, slightly suspenseful: low cello drone, muted piano ostinato, shimmering glass, a low pulse without drums

M3.chapter: M, 4, 5 (subscribe 1, you are fifth: Fable, behind you, the tips)
M3.mood: warm and sincere at first (felt piano, warm strings), a door opens a crack, quiet wonder; last third watchful and grounded, low pads and a slow pulse

M4.chapter: 6, 7 (the room, C4, the clue, newer + bigger, permission + power)
M4.mood: a windowless room: low drones, bowed glass, distant choir; then a clue in plain sight, patient insight with sparse felt piano over warm pads, a thousand identical machines humming in a vast hall

M5.mood: an ordinary evening a few months from now; mystical, warm, gently hopeful, a last slow felt-piano figure, a faint choir swell, fades out on one long decaying tone
